title: Mike McDaniel: I'm not living in hope, I'm living in reality about our offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike McDaniel: I'm not living in hope, I'm living in reality about our offense
sources.description: Chargers offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel got a vote of confidence from head coach Jim Harbaugh on Wednesday, but he knows that the status quo on offense isn't going to work.
